_comment: Tripwire config for the egress gate. Copy to never-egress.json and edit.
tripwire.js FAILS CLOSED: if never-egress.json is missing or unparseable,
every model call is blocked with CONFIG_ERROR. That is intentional.
block_terms are matched case-insensitively as substrings.
block_patterns are JavaScript regex sources, applied with flags 'gi'.
This template is deliberately employer-agnostic. Add the specific
codenames, client names, and internal identifiers for the current
engagement; remove them when the engagement ends. Nothing here is
hardcoded in the gate, so re-targeting is a config change only.
